name: hallucination_dolly_benchmark
description: A dataset of Dolly model outputs annotated for hallucinations and related factual errors. It is intended to measure a model's tendency to produce unsupported or fabricated content and to evaluate hallucination-detection classifiers or mitigation techniques. Labels enable both binary detection and qualitative analysis of hallucination types.
reputation: A niche, applied dataset used by safety practitioners and tooling teams for hallucination analysis; limited adoption beyond that community.
